query: After upgrading ComfyUI past v0.3.19, previously-working workflows fail with 'PlaySound.IS_CHANGED() missing 1 required positional argument' and 'PreviewBridge.doit() missing 1 required positional argument images' — validation errors on load.

desired.outcome: Confirmed by OP: upgrading both ComfyUI and ComfyUI-Manager to the newest versions resolves the signature-mismatch errors with PreviewBridge/custom-script nodes.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether solver recognizes IS_CHANGED()/doit() signature-mismatch errors as core↔custom-node API drift after a partial upgrade, and prescribes coordinated upgrade of ComfyUI + Manager instead of editing the workflow.
